title: 第8章 又是你
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“他昨晚明明可以跑，却偏要带着那些东西回来。”

苏悦平静地走进内室，眼皮也不抬，

“既然他自己选了留下来，那就得拿出点像样的本事。否则死了也活该，至于二寨主嘛……”

她把杏眼眯起来，眼底浮上一丝寒意。

这家伙觊觎山寨的头把交椅，已经不是一两天了。

之前甚至把主意打到了自己身上。

现在计划被林珝打乱，肯定急得跳脚。

“本小姐巴不得他的人有所动作！”

黑风寨看似声势浩大，但人心却一直不稳。

以前，老寨主身体好的时候还能压得住场面。

可这些年，他身体每况愈下，两个儿子又不成气候，各种牛鬼蛇神都蹦出了出来。

沈哥微微一怔，像是忽然明白了什么，“三小姐，你的意思是……让姑爷当这个鱼饵？”

“一个登徒子，他算什么姑爷！”

苏悦咬着嘴角轻哼一声，语调恢复了平常的冷度，凝视着灰蒙蒙天空，不再开口。

沈哥张了张嘴，最终没有再多说什么，无声地退出房间，把门带上。

屋子里安静下来。

苏悦还是站在窗前没有动。

那张一贯冷冰冰的面孔上，忽然多出了一分说不清的复杂。

“林珝，你不是想娶本小姐，完成林黑虎的遗愿吗？”

许久之后，她用只有自己能听得见的语气说，“那得看你能不能先在这里活下来。”

拜过堂，成了亲，那又怎样？

本小姐可不会委身下嫁一个窝囊废！

两天下来，林珝一直待在偏院那间小屋养伤，哪儿都没去。

肩上的箭创看着唬人，好在乌勒斥候那一箭射得偏，没伤着骨头。

他用领到的赏钱去伙房换了点刀伤药，捣碎了敷在伤口上，再用干净布条缠紧。

两天过去，伤口已经结了痂，手臂也能抬过头顶了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"He could have run away last night, but he had to come back with those things."

Su Yue walked into the inner room calmly without raising her eyelids.

"Since he chose to stay, he has to show some decent skills. Otherwise, he deserves to die. As for the second village leader..."

She narrowed her almond-shaped eyes, and there was a chill in her eyes.

This guy has been coveting the top spot in the cottage for more than a day or two.

I even had the idea to hit myself before.

Now that the plan has been disrupted by Lin Jue, he must be anxious.

"I hope his people will take action!"

Heifeng Village seems to be powerful, but people's hearts have always been unstable.

In the past, when the old village leader was in good health, he could still handle the situation.

But over the years, his health has been deteriorating, his two sons have become insignificant, and all kinds of monsters and monsters have appeared.

Brother Shen was slightly startled, as if he suddenly understood something, "Third Miss, what do you mean... to let my uncle be the bait?"

"What kind of brother-in-law is he?"

Su Yue bit the corner of her mouth and snorted, her tone returned to its normal coldness, she stared at the gray sky and said no more.

Brother Shen opened his mouth, but in the end without saying anything more, he silently exited the room and closed the door.

The room fell silent.

Su Yue still stood in front of the window and did not move.

That usually cold face suddenly had an indescribable complexity.

"Lin Jue, don't you want to marry me and fulfill Lin Heihu's last wish?"

After a long time, she said in a tone that only she could hear, "It depends on whether you can survive here first."

We went to court and got married, so what?

This young lady will not commit herself to marrying a loser!

For two days, Lin Jue stayed in the hut in the side courtyard to recuperate and didn't go anywhere.

The arrow wound on his shoulder looked horrifying, but fortunately Scout Ule's arrow missed the target and did not damage any bones.

He used the reward money he received to go to the kitchen to exchange for some medicine for knife wounds, crushed it and applied it to the wound, then tied it tightly with a clean cloth.

Two days later, the wound has scabbed over and I can lift my arm above my head.
